Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a SINGLE portrait 4:5 full-bleed keyframe for a layered animated Chinese classroom scene. The reference images define the SAME young brown-haired knight, silver gold armor, royal blue scarf/cape, and small yellow goggle helper in blue overalls. Raise rendering quality to polished cinematic animated-film illustration: dimensional faces, credible anatomy and hands, textured metals/leather, soft realistic warm window light, detailed castle war room.
Scene: calm pre-battle intelligence room. Knight seated on RIGHT half of frame, facing three-quarters left with an interested, determined gentle smile, looking toward a courier arriving from upper LEFT. His LEFTMOST hand extends horizontally toward center-left, palm open upward waiting to receive a rolled parchment. One natural black leather gloved open palm clearly visible at approximately x45%, y65% of whole canvas. His other hand rests on the wooden desk. Small yellow helper on lower LEFT behind an open laptop, looking toward the knight's waiting hand. Large wooden command desk across lower third, unrolled map with three blue/orange/teal tower symbols, brass compass, travel satchel. Tall arched window upper left, cream blue morning sky, shelves, blue banner and lantern upper right. All faces show subtle anticipation.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION for UI overlays: top 24% contains only room architecture/window/shadow and soft light, NO heads or hands. Faces centered y38-52%, knight at x68%, helper x24%. Waiting palm y65%, laptop near y68%. All essential action above y73%; bottom 24% mainly beautiful dark wooden desk edge suitable for overlay controls. Dense scene with no blank bands.
Do NOT draw owl or messenger bird anywhere: it will be a separately animated layer. Do NOT draw a scroll in the waiting palm, it must be empty. No magic glowing screens, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no logos or watermark. One continuous shot, no panels. Keep overall lighting readable, warm navy/cobalt/cream palette. Natural perspective, both hands anatomically coherent, no duplicated limbs.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: isolated animated-layer cutout on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Match the white-and-gold mechanical owl in the supplied reference. Single owl only, no other characters, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow rectangle.
A polished cinematic animated-film mechanical owl courier, front three-quarter view looking slightly down and right. White ivory enamel body, gold brass edging and articulated feather plates, cobalt blue glass eyes and small blue breast gem, charming intelligent expression. Wings spread symmetrically outward, angled only a little upward, perfect for separate wing flapping layers; BODY AND HEAD in middle 36% of canvas; left wing mostly within left 38%, right wing mostly within right 38%; wing roots hidden behind body. Feet and two EMPTY open gold talons visible below body, able to carry a separate scroll. No scroll or paper in this image. Both wings fully inside frame, generous 4% transparent margin. Owl fills most width. Warm key light from upper left, soft cool blue fill from right, believable metallic material, exquisite feathers, clear silhouette, readable at 150px wide. Landscape 3:2 canvas, no text, watermark, border, glow cloud or background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a single small rolled parchment courier scroll isolated on transparent alpha background, no scenery, no cast shadow floor, no letters/numbers/logos. Polished cinematic fantasy animated-film prop. Ivory warm paper curled at both ends with a thick royal blue ribbon wrapped around middle and round gold wax seal embossed with a simple three-tower silhouette. Scroll lies almost horizontal with slight diagonal upward right, seen from three-quarter above/front, warm upper-left light, natural paper fibers and shading, detailed gold and cloth materials. One scroll only. Wide 3:2 canvas, prop centered occupies 80% width and about45%height, clear silhouette, transparent surroundings. Matching the brown-haired knight's castle war room and mechanical owl courier. No feather, no hand, no wing or other objects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the edit target and must remain EXACTLY the same portrait composition, dimensions, camera, characters, facial expressions, lighting, laptop, map, background, open window, desk and all objects. Image2 is the scroll-prop reference.
Change ONLY the knight's outstretched black leather gloved hand and the tiny area immediately above that palm: the hand has now RECEIVED the rolled parchment from image2. Place a SMALL horizontal rolled parchment with blue ribbon and gold seal into his existing palm, not elsewhere. The scroll must occupy about26% of total canvas width, centered x41%, with its cylinder center near y56% of whole canvas; lower edge resting on existing palm around y59%. Fingers curl gently and anatomically around the LOWER portion of the scroll with thumb providing support, a clear believable hand-off grip. Maintain exactly the same extended armored forearm, cuff and wrist position. Cloth, paper, glove contact shadows coherent. Scroll can extend left and right beyond fingers naturally. Do not enlarge it into a big book or cylinder. Do NOT move his arm, body, head or fingers beyond the small hand area. Do NOT add owl, new hands, extra objects or text. This is a matched end keyframe for an animation, so preserve every pixel outside the receiving hand and scroll region as closely as possible. No borders or panels.

notes: The browser animates layered illustrations and blends a receiving-hand keyframe; this is not an image-to-video character performance.
Code progress is based on checked fill answers; the student still runs the Python code in Notebook to create the actual CSV.
